items.raw_excerpt: Just one in five adults expect to fully retire and stop working in the traditional manner, according to new research from Irish Life.
items.summary_en: A new survey from Irish Life found that only one in five adults expect to fully retire and stop working in the traditional way. The research highlights changing attitudes toward retirement in Ireland.
items.summary_ko: 아일랜드 생명보험사의 새 조사에 따르면 기존 방식대로 완전히 은퇴해 일을 멈출 것으로 기대하는 성인은 5명 중 1명에 불과한 것으로 나타났다. 이번 연구는 아일랜드에서 은퇴에 대한 인식이 변화하고 있음을 보여준다.
items.title_en: One in five people expect to fully retire

items.raw_excerpt: Gold fever is set to grip Central Otago later this month, as it is transformed into a battleground for about 200 of the world's elite gold panners.
items.summary_en: About 200 top gold panners will compete in Central Otago this month. The region becomes a battleground for the world's quickest gold panners.

items.title_en: World's fastest gold panners gather in Cromwell

items.raw_excerpt: Zum 50. Todestag Hermann Hesses hat sich Jo Baier der frühen Erzählung „Die Heimkehr“ angenommen. Es geht um die Suche nach der Heimat, nach seelisch-geistiger Verwurzelung, nach Geborgenheit in der Gemeinschaft. Wunderbar ausgestattet, angenehm kontemplativ und blickintensiv inszeniert, vorzüglich besetzt, stehen dem Film allein die Sehgewohnheiten im Weg. items.summary_en: A new TV film explores the search for home and spiritual roots in Hermann Hesse's early story 'Die Heimkehr.' The contemplative production features strong performances and beautiful cinematography, though its quiet pace may challenge modern viewers.
items.summary_ko: 새 TV 영화는 헤르만 헤세의 초기 작품 '귀향'을 통해 고향과 정신적 뿌리, 공동체의 안식을 탐구합니다. 명상적이고 세련된 이 작품은 뛰어난 연기와 아름다운 영상미를 보여주지만, 현대 시청자에게는 다소 조용한 스타일이 도전이 될 수 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Dutch primary schools are now expected to make room for the languages pupils speak at home, like Turkish, Polish and Arabic. New national curriculum standards will encourage teachers to allow students to use their mother tongue to prepare for class or better understand material if it helps them. The change comes from updated core objectives (kerndoelen) for the Dutch language, which became law in August and set out what children are meant to learn. items.summary_en: New national curriculum standards in the Netherlands encourage teachers to let primary school pupils use their mother tongue at school. Students can use languages like Turkish, Polish, or Arabic to prepare for class or better understand material. The updated rules became law in August as part of revised Dutch-language objectives.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드의 새로운 교육과정 기준에 따라 초등학교 교사들은 학생들이 수업에서 모국어를 사용하도록 장려하게 된다. 학생들은 터키어, 폴란드어, 아랍어 등을 활용해 수업 준비를 하거나 내용을 더 잘 이해할 수 있다. 해당 규정은 네덜란드어 관련 개정 목표의 일환으로 8월부터 시행됐다.
items.title_en: Dutch primary schools to welcome home languages in class

items.title_original: Dutch schools must make space for languages spoken at home

items.raw_excerpt: International residents in Austria have spelled out a long list of complaints about the infamous MA35 immigration office in Vienna, although there were many who appreciated the service.
items.summary_en: Foreign residents in Vienna made a long list of complaints about MA 35, the city's immigration office. They said it is insensitive and inefficient. But some people said the service was helpful.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아 빈에서 살고 있는 외국인 주민들이 이민 사무소 MA35에 대한 긴 불만 목록을 털어놓았다. 이들은 사무소가 무감각하고 비효율적이라고 말했다. 다만 서비스를 긍정적으로 보는 사람들도 있었다.
items.title_en: Foreign residents list complaints about Vienna immigration office
items.title_ko: 빈의 외국인 주민들, 이민 사무소 MA35에 불만 가득
items.title_original: 'Insensitive and inefficient': Your verdict on Vienna's immigration office MA 35

items.raw_excerpt: Often recognised as the most beautiful metro station in Lisbon, Parque is named after the Eduardo VII Park, where the metro station is located.
items.summary_en: Parque is often called the most beautiful metro station in Lisbon. It is named after Eduardo VII Park, where the station is located. The name comes from the park above the station.
